text.m.home.t: LYNX SHARE: a lightweight open-source DAW that opens FL Studio and Ableton Live projects
text.m.home.d: LYNX SHARE is a free, open-source DAW for Windows, macOS and Linux with FL Studio's way of working: Channel rack, Piano roll, Playlist and Mixer. It opens .flp, .als and .flm projects and exports .flp and .als.
text.m.features.d: What LYNX SHARE does in the current release: the windows, the clip-launch layout, .flp, .als and .flm projects, built-in instruments and effects, and the plugin formats it hosts.
text.m.download.d: Download LYNX SHARE for Windows, macOS or Linux: installer, portable zip, dmg, AppImage and tar.gz, with install notes for each system.
text.m.updates.d: What is new, better and fixed in each LYNX SHARE release, newest first.
text.m.wiki.d: The LYNX SHARE manual: getting started, every window of the workspace, a page for each built-in instrument and effect, settings, shortcuts, file formats and troubleshooting.
text.m.faq.d: Short answers about LYNX SHARE: price and licence, systems, FL Studio and Ableton Live projects, plugins, privacy and updates.
text.up.sub: What changed in each release, newest first. Every entry links to the full notes on GitHub.
text.home.latestAll: Everything in this release, and earlier ones
text.wiki.sub: The manual for the current release. Start with Getting started if you are new, or search for what you need.
text.wiki.enOnly: The wiki pages are in English only for now.
text.faq.sub: Short answers. The wiki has the details.
text.m.why.d: What LYNX SHARE does that other DAWs do not: online sessions, FL Studio and Ableton Live projects both ways, FL plugin settings on its own engines, two workflows, plugin crash protection, free on three systems.
text.m.fixes.d: Common complaints about FL Studio, Ableton Live and DAWs in general, and what the released LYNX SHARE does about each one, with its limits.
text.m.cat.d: Every instrument, effect and tool built into LYNX SHARE, each with a picture of its editor, what it is for and a link to its wiki page.
text.cat.sub: {0} instruments, effects and tools are built into LYNX SHARE {1}. Each picture is the plugin's own editor, drawn by the released program. Third-party plugins (VST3, CLAP and others) load next to them.
text.cat.tm: FL Studio and the names of its plugins are trademarks of Image-Line Software. They are used here only to say which plugin's saved settings each LYNX SHARE engine opens. The engines are LYNX SHARE's own code; nothing from Image-Line is in them.
text.home.catL: Synths, drums, EQs, compressors, reverbs, delays and tools, each with a picture and a wiki page.
text.wkg.start.d: What LYNX SHARE is, installing it, setting up sound, a tour of the window and a first song from an empty project to an exported file.
text.wkg.work.d: One page per window, then the things you do in them: automation, recording, exporting, MIDI controllers, undo, online sessions and opening projects from other DAWs.
text.wkg.plug.d: How the built-in plugins work, and a page for each one: what it is for, its controls in a table and a few tips.
text.wkg.ref.d: Every settings page, the shortcuts, file formats, the command line, building from source and what to do when something goes wrong.
